config.label: DashScope API key

config.label: Default chat model id
config.description: Default chat model id. Options: qwen-max, qwen-plus (default), qwen-turbo, qwen-long.

config.label: Default embedding model id
config.description: Default embedding model id. Defaults to text-embedding-v3.

config.label: Custom DashScope endpoint
config.description: Custom DashScope endpoint. Defaults to international (dashscope-intl.aliyuncs.com).
